title: Affine-weight orders and shifted character actions
statement: Let $P$ be an integral root datum on additive lattices $X,Y$, with indexed roots $P.root$ and coroots, and let $b$ be a simple-root base with finite support $\Delta$. Define $y\le_b x$ by $x-y\in\sum_{\alpha\in\Delta}\mathbf N\alpha$, and $y<_b x$ by $y\le_b x$ and $y\ne x$. For $\rho\in X$ define the closed shifted dominant chamber by $\langle x+\rho,\alpha^\vee\rangle\ge0$ for every simple root, and define $s_\alpha\mathbin\cdot x=s_\alpha(x+\rho)-\rho$. For $p\in\mathbf N$, a lowering edge from $y$ to $x$ means that for a positive root $\beta$ and integer $n\ge0$, $y=s_\beta\mathbin\cdot x+np\beta$ and $y\le_b x$; linkage is the finite reflexive transitive closure of these edges. For any action $a$ on $X$ define $a_\rho(w,x)=a(w,x+\rho)-\rho$. For a field $F$ [def-weil-field], $F$-group schemes $T,S$ [def-sc-group-scheme], a morphism $i_T:T\to S$, the actual normalizer quotient $W$ of [def-sfb-rank-one-root-interfaces], and $a:W\to\operatorname{Aut}(T)$, define the character action by $w\chi=\chi\circ a(w)^{-1}$ on $X^*(T)$.
